title: Live: content chunking repository
summary: New tests/integration/test_chunking.py — ChunkRepository round-trips, vector search over chunks, and scope-scoped erasure against real Db2 (ORC-2).
description: repositories/chunks.py's ChunkRepository (insert_chunk, delete_by_source, erase_by_scope, list_all, list_all_for_scope, search_chunks) has no live-Db2 coverage. Add tests/integration/test_chunking.py: insert several chunks for one source document under one scope via the live pool, assert list_all_for_scope() and list_all() return them with correct ordering/pagination; run search_chunks() with a real embedding vector and assert nearest-neighbour correctness using the same unit-vector technique as test_core.py's TestVectorSearch (make_unit_vec from conftest.py); call delete_by_source() and assert only that source's chunks are removed, others in the same scope untouched; call erase_by_scope() and assert a full scope's chunks are gone while a sibling scope's chunks survive. Define local fixtures inside this file only.

comments.text: Done. Created tests/integration/test_chunking.py — 13 tests: insert/list_all_for_scope round-trip, list_all pagination, search_chunks nearest-neighbour (unit vector), delete_by_source targeted removal, erase_by_scope full scope erasure with sibling intact.
